Hi Markus,

We had a productive demo last week and the leadership team wants to formalize an evaluation plan so we can move to a PO and pilot decision within 6 weeks. Can you share a MAP template (we prefer a living GDoc) that covers evaluation tracks (tech, security, purchasing) and a suggested close timeline?

Appreciate any seed doc you can share — happy to take your recommended skeleton and populate it.

Thanks,
Simon

Please propose a couple of time slots for next week — Marissa will run the workshop and Jasmine will own the acceptance criteria template.

Simon — thanks for moving this forward. I've copied a minimal MAP-template-v2.gdoc into the shared folder (also listed in links above). Notes from my quick pass:

Top-level structure (what I added):
- Overview & Stakeholder Roster (owner + escalation path)
- Tracks (parallel):
  - Technical Validation (owner: ClearPath Eng / Redwood Solutions)
  - Security & Compliance (owner: ClearPath Security / Redwood Trust & Safety)
  - Commercial / Procurement (owner: ClearPath Finance / Redwood Sales Ops)
- Acceptance Criteria (per-track, binary where possible)
- Week-by-week milestones (W0–W6) with gating rules
- Risks & mitigations (quick bullets)

Suggested acceptance criteria examples (short):
- Tech: end-to-end latency under agreed SLO on sample dataset; integration test harness green; CI job for inference reproducible
- Security: SOC-2 scoping answers confirmed; access model defined; audit log retention agreed
- Commercial: PO terms templated; procurement contact assigned; license usage and billing cadence aligned

Quick ask for the kickoff: can you drop the name/email of the procurement owner so we can add them to the doc? Also, if there are any mandatory legal terms (e.g., data residency or specific MSA clauses) flag them now so we can include in the procurement track.

I'll bring a filled example of W0–W2 for a similar infra pilot to the workshop; Jasmine will bring the acceptance criteria template (clear pass/fail rows). Attached: MAP-template-v2.gdoc (link stub) and my kickoff checklist.

–Marissa
